text:
amanda: Quick one 1 1 trying to run our JS SDK in a Bun edge worker and also run Deno tests. Node works, Bun throws `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for ./dist/index.cjs. Anyone seen export map hairpins?
ryan: Bun prefers ESM. If package.json has main->cjs and exports maps node->cjs it can still pick the cjs and fail. Add an explicit ESM entry or an ESM shim.
leo: Also important: webcrypto + fetch differences. Our auth uses `crypto.subtle` and PBKDF2; Bun/Deno subtle impls differ. Guard with `const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle ?? (await import('node:crypto').then(c=>c.webcrypto.subtle))`.
amanda: The SDK calls `response.body.getReader()` in a couple places which fails in Bun. We should feature-detect and fall back to arrayBuffer.
ryan: Typings: Deno users report our `.d.ts` uses `node:` imports. Deno rejects that. Consider shipping `dist/deno.d.ts` and an exports entry for `./deno`.
leo: Short-term patch: create `deno.mjs` that re-exports the mjs build and a cleaned d.ts. That unblocked our Deno CI.
doc-bot: note: file a DX issue to auto-detect `globalThis.Bun` and flip to a Bun-safe loader path.
amanda: I'll paste my tiny patch after lunch. Adding an examples/edge-bun-deno sample and README would be great to stop new user friction.
